'''Arts and culture'''
*Sister Pietra Luana (Etra) Modica, a [[Missionaries of St. Charles Borromeo|Scalabrinian]] Catholic nun, is the new Secretary General of the [[Pontifical Urbaniana University]]. The appointment was signed by Cardinal [[Luis Antonio Tagle]], Prefect of the [[Congregation for the Evangelization of Peoples]] and university Grand Chancellor. It is the first time since its founding in 1627 that this position has been assigned to a woman. [http://www.fides.org/en/news/70894-VATICAN_Urbaniana_University_for_the_first_time_the_new_General_Secretary_is_a_nun_a_Scalabrinian_missionary (Fides)]

'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**Journalist Sayed Maroof Sadat, two [[Taliban]] soldiers and a civilian are killed by suspected [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|ISIS-K]] gunmen in [[Jalalabad]] after opening fire against a vehicle. [https://www.repubblica.it/esteri/2021/10/02/news/afghanistan_giornalista_ucciso_da_uomini_armati_a_jalalabad-320448540/ (La Repubblica)]
**Five [[Pakistan]]i soldiers are killed by gunmen at the border with [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.aninews.in/news/world/asia/five-pakistani-soldiers-killed-in-terror-attack-in-north-waziristan20211003010837/ (Ani News)]
*[[Insurgency in Cabo Delgado]]
**Rajab Awadhi Ndanjili, one of the leaders of the [[Islamic State|ISIL]]-linked groups, has been killed by [[Mozambique]] security forces in [[Cabo Delgado Province|Cabo Delgado]] during an operation a week ago. Seventeen other terrorists were also killed. [https://allafrica.com/stories/202110030029.html (All Africa)]
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**Clashes between [[government of Yemen|government]] [[Republic of Yemen Armed Forces|forces]] and the [[separatist]] [[Southern Transitional Council]] (STC) in [[Aden]] kill at least four people. The government has been battling the separatists of the STC and the [[Houthis]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/fighting-between-yemeni-separatist-forces-kills-four-aden-say-sources-2021-10-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mali War]]
**A [[United Nations]] peacekeeper is killed and three others are seriously injured when an [[improvised explosive device|IED]] detonates near where they were patrolling in the volatile north of the country, near [[Algeria-Mali border|the border]] with [[Algeria]]. [https://www.dhakatribune.com/world/africa/2021/10/02/un-peacekeeper-killed-in-blast-in-mali-s-troubled-north (''Dhaka Tribune'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Four people are dead and two others are injured in [[Cosenza]], [[Calabria]], [[Italy]], after accidentally falling into a vat of grape [[must]]. [https://cosenza.gazzettadelsud.it/articoli/cronaca/2021/10/02/tragedia-a-paola-quattro-morti-in-seguito-ad-un-incidente-durante-la-vendemmia-a8cadab7-84e1-42b4-b7aa-a168b85833b8/ (''Gazzetta del Sud'')]
*A fire breaks out on [[Rome]]'s [[Ponte dell'Industria]], or Industry Bridge, due to an electrical fire near gas pipelines and causes portions of the structure of the bridge to collapse.  [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2021/10/03/Italy-fire-causes-partial-collapse-Rome-Iron-Bridge/7491633273481/ (UPI)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[Singapore]] surpasses 100,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/singapore-tops-100000-covid-19-cases-reports-4-more-deaths-2217041 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]] surpasses 800,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2021/10/03/vietnam-reports-5490-new-covid-19-cases-on-saturday-oct-2-as-total-cases-surpass-800000 (''The Star'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Victoria]]
****[[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] reports a record 1,488 new cases and two deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. The [[COVID-19 lockdown|Victoria lockdown]] is also extended to [[City of Greater Shepparton|Greater Shepparton]] after an increase in new COVID-19 cases in the regional community. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-10-02/victoria-new-covid-cases-melbourne-lockdown/100509348 (ABC News Australia)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
***[[Argentina]] receives a shipment of 1,673,000 doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine]] and has now received more than 70 million vaccine doses since the start of the vaccination campaign. Health minister [[Carla Vizzotti]] also announces that the country will receive a shipment of 7.2 million doses of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] to be used for teenagers. [https://diputadosbsas.com.ar/nota/22994/llegan_mas_de_160_mil_vacunas_astrazeneca_y_argentina_supera_las_70_millones_de_dosis/ (DBSAS)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nicaragua]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Nicaragua]]
***[[Nicaragua]] authorizes the [[Cuba]]n Abdala and Soberana [[COVID-19 vaccine]]s for emergency use. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/nicaragua-authorises-two-covid-19-vaccines-cuba-cuban-firm-says-2021-10-02/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021 North Kosovo protests]]
**Protests in [[North Kosovo]] end with the protesters removing barricades and vehicles used to block the border crossings, according to an agreement reached in [[Brussels]] two days ago, which will end the ban on [[Vehicle registration plates of Serbia|Serbian license plates]] on October 4. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/serbs-unblock-roads-kosovo-nato-moves-end-car-plate-row-2021-10-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Georgian local elections]]
**Georgians head to the polls to elect the bodies of local government in the country. The election is being closely watched in the aftermath of yesterday's arrest of [[Mikheil Saakashvili]], who returned from [[exile]] in order to support his party. The pro-[[Western world|Western]] former leader had a ruling in his favor when [[Interpol]] turned down a request for his arrest. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/2/polls-open-in-georgia-after-former-president-saakashvilis-arrest (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2021 Qatari general election]]
**[[Qataris]] head to the polls to elect 30 members of the [[Consultative Assembly of Qatar|Consultative Assembly]] in the country's first legislative elections. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/qatar-holds-first-legislative-elections-2021-10-02/  (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Madagascar food crisis]]
**[[President of Madagascar]] [[Andry Rajoelina]] visits the famine-hit southern region of the country and promises the prompt inauguration of a water pipeline from the Efaho River to the [[Ambovombe]] districts after the allocation of 322 million euros of a loan requested from the [[International Monetary Fund]]. Rajoelina also promises more food aid to those affected by the disaster. [https://www.madagascar-tribune.com/Andry-Rajoelina-en-periple-dans-le-Sud.html (''Madagascar Tribune'')]
